You need to free the [[Reaper]]s by slaying the [[Terrorweb Dryder]]s imprisoning them.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Summon the [[Reaper of the Chaos Planes]].
* Summon the [[Reaper of the Ice Wastes]].
* Summon the [[Reaper of the Bone Pits]].
* Summon the [[Reaper of the Spawning Pools]].
* Summon the [[Reaper of the Forgotten Vale]].
* Summon the [[Reaper of the Twin Serpent Mountains]].
* Return to [[Reaper of the Labyrinth]] for your reward.

===Reward===
*10,000 [[Experience]]

==Walkthrough==
Completing this quest will require you to travel the whole Underworld, killing groups of three [[Terrorweb Dryder]]s at the six other monuments of [[Grenth]]. Upon accepting the quest one group of Terrorwebs will spawn next to each of the monuments. When your party kills one of the groups the corresponding [[Reaper]] is spawned next to the monument.

Pay extra caution at the monuments of [[Forgotten Vale]], [[Twin Serpent Mountains]] and [[Spawning Pools]]. Kill the surrounding monsters before the [[Terrorweb Dryder]]s, because otherwise they might attack the Reaper and cause your party to be taken back to the outpost from which you entered the Underworld.

As the quest suggests, once a Reaper is freed, you will be able to speak to him and he can teleport you to any other Reaper that you have freed. The Reapers also have quests to offer, but be aware that taking any quests without consulting the party is unwise as they tend to spawn dangerous groups and might cause a party wipe if the party isn't prepared.

'''Note:''' Although it is very tempting to take the quest immediately after completing the preceding quest or soon after clearing one or two nearby areas due to the offered teleportation possibility, it might be wise to clear the furthermost problematic monuments before accepting the quest to avoid having to fight against the Terrorwebs and the other enemies surrounding the monuments at the same time.
